sources_note: Name, description, grade and count for every trophy come from the official list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are our own words, drawn from the official description; the game released 19 Nov 2026 and in-game details are not yet verified.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then collectibles, then the activity grinds, then the money cleanup — and this trophy pops last. Name, description and grade come from Exophase and PSNProfiles; the game released 19 Nov 2026 and in-game details are not yet verified.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is the first mission of the story and cannot be skipped. It unlocks when the mission completes, so simply finish it as part of the story. Treat it as missable: mission replayability is unconfirmed at launch, so earn it during this mission. Name, description and grade come from Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 of the story; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. There is no side requirement — just play the story through to the chapter's close. Treat it as missable: mission replayability is unconfirmed at launch, so earn it during Chapter 1. Name, description and grade come from Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road

Name, description and grade come from Exophase and PSNProfiles; the exact completion checklist is not in the official description and is not yet verified in-game.
